newsitem.title: USA: Occidental names two execs for oil and gas unit.
newsitem.headline: Occidental names two execs for oil and gas unit.

text.p: Occidental Petroleum Corp Wednesday named two key executives to lead its worldwide oil and gas operation.

In a statement, the company said David Hentschel, currently president and chief executive officer of Canadian Occidental Petroleum Ltd., will be chairman and chief executive officer of Occidental Oil and Gas Corp and Roger Abel, currently chairman of Conoco Exploration Production Europe Ltd., will be president and chief operating officer of Occidental Oil and Gas Corp.
Conoco is a unit of DuPont Co.
